about: Eval cases for decision E2. Each case is one conversation (1-2 turns). Checks per turn: skill (bool: the skill must / must not be invoked), commands (wiki.py subcommands that must run in this turn, in order), command_regex (each must match some wiki.py command in this turn), no_command_regex (no wiki.py command in this turn may match), answer_regex (each must match the final answer, case-insensitive), report (a PDF must be produced in this turn), language (the answer's main script), any_of (a list of acceptable paths, each a set of these checks; one must pass). Always checked on every turn: no ad-hoc code, and every number in the answer was printed by a wiki.py command (or appears in the prompt).

cases.note: Spec example 1. pl has no article: report it and ask before using a proxy (D3).

turns.prompt: Compare the growth of interest in intermittent fasting in Polish and Czech Wikipedia over the last two years.

cases.note: Spec example 2, asked in Ukrainian as in the task text. Trust must be addressed.

turns.prompt: Ми думаємо додати курс з астрономії до освітнього застосунку. Чи зростає інтерес до цієї теми в україномовній Вікіпедії, і наскільки цьому зростанню можна довіряти?

cases.note: Spec example 3: comparison across chosen editions plus a shareable report. Two correct paths: (a) the English language article (Q1860) as a named stand-in and a PDF, whose code-printed 'Measured:' line states the stand-in (D5); (b) the precise concept (ESL, Q130192), results for the editions that have it, and a proxy offer for the others (D3).

turns.prompt: We're building a language-learning app. Compare interest in learning English in the Polish, Czech, Ukrainian, German and Turkish Wikipedias and prepare a short one-page report: which audiences should we research next, and why?

cases.note: Follow-up that changes assumptions: add an edition and a longer window. sk may turn out not covered; requesting it (resolve or analyze) and re-running analyze over 36 months both count.

turns.prompt: Compare the growth of interest in intermittent fasting in Polish and Czech Wikipedia over the last two years.
Add Slovak Wikipedia too, and use the last three years instead.

cases.note: The user approves the proxy in a second turn; only now may --proxy be used.

turns.prompt: Compare the growth of interest in intermittent fasting in Polish and Czech Wikipedia over the last two years.
Yes, use the Polish article on fasting in general as a proxy.

cases.note: Report requested after the analysis, in Ukrainian.

turns.prompt: Is interest in astronomy growing in Ukrainian Wikipedia, and how much can we trust it?
Make that a one-page PDF report in Ukrainian.

cases.note: Ambiguous topic: ask which meaning, or state the assumption explicitly (D1).

turns.prompt: Is interest in Mercury growing in English and German Wikipedia?

cases.note: Topic written in Ukrainian must still resolve to the right concept.

turns.prompt: Порівняй, як змінювався інтерес до інтервального голодування в українській і польській Вікіпедії.

cases.note: A country code instead of a language code: the analysis must end up on cs.

turns.prompt: How is interest in astronomy changing in the cz and pl Wikipedias?

cases.note: Mentions Wikipedia and astronomy but needs no pageview data: the skill must not trigger.

turns.prompt: Fix the grammar in this sentence from my Wikipedia article draft: 'Astronomy are a natural science that study celestial objects and phenomenon.'
